entry.name: rnbo_gatetotrig
entry.description: An event rate gate to trigger operator. Produces a value of 1 after transition from zero or less to greater than zero (pos) or a value of 0 greater than zero to less or equal transition (neg).

arguments.name: val
arguments.digest: The input value or signal to convert
arguments.description: A bipolar input value or signal transitioning across zero can be used to trigger a single sample impulse. The @edge option sets the direction. Optionally, the initial value can be set as the argument.
